Terms of use

By using Kilómetro Real you accept these terms. They are simple: we want the information to be useful and for you to know its limits.

What Kilómetro Real is

A free, informational website that estimates what owning a car in Spain costs: depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. We don't sell cars, we're not a dealer or broker, and brands don't pay to appear.

Figures are indicative

Prices are list prices without discounts or incentives; consumption and depreciation are average estimates. Your case may differ. Before buying, confirm price, incentives and terms with the dealer or manufacturer. See how we calculate.

Not advice

Nothing published here is financial, tax or legal advice. The finance and incentive calculators are simulations.

Permitted use

You may read, share and link to any page. Mass copying of content or data, or automated access that overloads the site, is not allowed.

Advertising and links

The site is funded by Google AdSense ads, chosen by Google; they are not our recommendation. We are not responsible for external websites we link to.

Errors and changes

If you spot wrong data, let us know and we'll fix it. We may update these terms; the version published here always applies.
